nyuchi · workspace tools

Workspace tools for the Bundu ecosystem

Email signature management and brand design tools for Nyuchi Africa and the Bundu ecosystem — signatures, Nyuchi Studio social cards, and an MCP server for AI agents.

Generate SignatureSetup Guide

Tools

Available tools

Gmail Add-on

A powerful Gmail sidebar add-on with User and Admin tabs for managing email signatures across your organization.

Signature Generator

Interactive web tool for generating branded email signatures. Supports multiple Nyuchi brands with live preview.

Web Dashboard

Full-featured admin dashboard for enterprise signature management. Bulk deploy, preview templates, and manage users.

Nyuchi Studio

Generative social cards in the Bundu mineral design language. Seven mineral palettes, five formats, five layouts — export as SVG or PNG.

MCP Server

Connect AI agents like Claude to these tools via the Model Context Protocol at tools.nyuchi.dev/mcp — generate signatures and design assets from a conversation.

Features

What it does

Multi-Brand Support

The four Bundu-ecosystem brands plus their divisions, with consistent branding and customizable templates.

Domain-Wide Deployment

Push signatures to all users in your Google Workspace domain with one click.

Self-Service Generation

Users can generate their own signatures with the interactive web tool.

Automatic Updates

Schedule daily signature updates to keep user information current.

Brand Design Studio

Nyuchi Studio social cards generated in the Bundu mineral design system.

MCP for AI Agents

An MCP server at tools.nyuchi.dev/mcp lets Claude and other agents use these tools.
